description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the cashu-emoji CLI at /opt/cashu-emoji/bin/cashu-emoji.js. 2. It reads the full chat log file (not just the emoji line) and passes the entire contents to `node ./bin/cashu-emoji.js decode '<full message text>' --metadata --json` — critical trap: passing only the emoji or stripping surrounding text may work, but passing the whole message is the documented recommended approach. 3. It parses the JSON output to extract the `text` field (the cashuB token), the `metadata.mint`, `metadata.unit`, and `metadata.amount` fields. 4. It runs `node ./bin/cashu-emoji.js encode '🌰' '<decoded_token>'` using the chestnut emoji (🌰) as the new carrier — not the original peanut (🥜). 5. It writes a `payment_verification.json` file containing: `decoded_token` (the full cashuB string), `metadata` (object with mint/unit/amount), and `re_encoded_emoji` (the chestnut emoji string with hidden token). The eval verifies: the token is correctly decoded, metadata matches the embedded mint URL, the re-encoded emoji round-trips back to the same token, and the carrier is 🌰 not 🥜.
